issues: The toast-copy variant of the downgrade guard specified in the review request ('Solo is a one-person plan' toast with a 'Manage participants' action button on click) is unreachable via the UI because the 'Switch to Solo' button is rendered disabled when >1 active participants. The changePlan(plan==='solo') branch in Settings.jsx:337-346 therefore only fires as defense-in-depth (e.g. direct call) and is not visible to the end user. UX is still safe: disabled state + inline explanatory copy on the Solo card + a separate 'Manage participants' link cover the requirement, but this is a different presentation from mobile parity (mobile shows an actual toast). Flagging for main agent to decide whether the disabled-button UX is intentional or the button should remain enabled to surface the toast.
